thread:
alex: Heads-up — PR #4326 (migration guide + SDK snippet fixes) is ready for final review but the docs-preview job is failing intermittently. Need a reviewer to approve and merge before Friday release window. Can someone pick this up?

maggie: I can take a look today. whats failing in the preview?

alex: Thanks. The build logs show an NPM install timeout, plus one broken relative link in the migration guide. Quick snippets: `npm run docs:preview` errors at `node-gyp` step. Docs preview link: https://ci.redwood/4326/build

sanjeev: I can triage the link + snippets. For the preview build, try clearing the cache on the job and re-run — Docker layer occasionally hits timeouts. 

kat: FYI I'm out Wed-Thu but can do a final pass tomorrow morning (PST). If someone else can trigger a retry, that would help.

ash: small nit — the SDK snippet uses `client.generate()` but the latest SDK exposes `client.responses.create()`; I'll submit a tiny fix now.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview (build 1187) failed — `npm ERR! code ETIMEDOUT` — <https://ci.redwood/4326/build|view logs> :warning:

maggie: @ash thanks — appreciate the snippet update. @sanjeev can you update the broken relative link path to `/docs/migrate/v1-to-v2#keystore`? That fixed it locally for me.

sanjeev: Done — pushed a commit to the branch. Also added a fallback note for older SDKs.

alex: Great. Who can rerun the preview? I don't have permission on the CI project.

kat: @maggie can you trigger the rebuild? I can re-check once it's green.

maggie: kicked off rebuild (re-run job). Linking the run: https://ci.redwood/4326/build/1188

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview (build 1188) succeeded — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

kat: Looks good to me. Approving now.

maggie: approved too. Alex — feel free to merge after a quick squash if you want a single commit. I'd recommend merging post-UTC 18:00 to avoid the midday traffic spike during the release window.

alex: Will squash & merge at 18:15 UTC. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. I've also added a one-line note to OWNERS about SDK-snippets -> ash for future assignments.

maggie: awesome, thanks — and maybe we should add a short doc in the runbook about the flaky npm cache step so it's easier next time.

sanjeev: added a runbook TODO in the branch.

alex: closing thread once merged. :rocket:
